buildCommand: export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:/rust/bin:$PATH" && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && WBV=$(grep -A2 '^name = "wasm-bindgen"$' Cargo.lock | grep '^version' | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f2) && echo "wasm-bindgen lib version: $WBV" && cargo install wasm-bindgen-cli --vers $WBV && mkdir -p dist/assets && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir dist --out-name photostep target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/photostep.wasm && cp web/index.html dist/index.html && cp assets/logo.svg dist/assets/logo.svg && ls -la dist dist/assets
